FAQS

Here are the most common questions you have asked us. Contact us if you have any other questions.

What kind of things will I do in the games?

You’ll decipher clues, uncover hidden locations, communicate with characters, solve physical puzzles, interact with people you meet, and make choices that affect your path in the story… Watch this video to find out more.

When can I play HiddenCity?

The games run seven days a week, at times stated in Explore the Games.

When do I choose my time slot?

You can either choose a time slot at the time of booking, or later when you are setting up your teams. You can change your date and time slot at any time before you play.

When do I set up my teams?

You'll set up your teams after you have booked. You can do this straight after booking, or at a later point.

How do I set up my teams?

Sign in to your game, and assign players into teams of 2-6 players. Choose a team captain and team name for each team. Provide an email address and mobile number for each team captain.

How do I start my game?

Once you have set up your teams, team captains will receive a confirmation email and message (via WhatsApp or SMS) from HiddenCity, which includes your start location. On the day, when you are at the start location and ready to play, the captain of team 1 starts the game by replying 'begin' to the message from HiddenCity.

Who will receive messages?

All players can be set up to receive messages, via WhatsApp or SMS. Once you have set up your teams, each team captain will get a message from HiddenCity. Captains can reply with a teammate’s mobile number e.g. “07900 123 123”. The teammate will then recieve a message, asking them to provide their details. Once that's done they’ll also be sent clues, and can reply on behalf of your team. Add further teammates in separate messages.

You can also add teammates in the same way at any point during the game.

How much do messages cost?

WhatsApp messages that you send and receive are done so via cellular connection or Wifi, so as long as you haven’t exceeded your mobile data allowance, or you’re connected to a free Wifi network, your mobile provider won’t charge you for these. If your phone is roaming, data charges might apply.

SMS messages that you send are charged at your standard network rate, or may be free with your phone package. There is no charge to receive SMS messages.

How do the games work with multiple players?

With two or more players you'll set up teams of up to 6 players. If you have multiple teams you'll play competitively head-to-head, in a race to the finish.

Can I add more players or teams?

Yes – sign in to your game using the Game ID and password emailed to the lead organiser, and you'll see an option to add players.

Can I change my team details?

Yes – you can change your team captains and mobile numbers any time before you begin, by signing in to your game.

Can I change the date and time of my game?

Yes – you can change the date or time of your game by signing in to your game and clicking on "update" next to the date or time window.

Can I get a refund?

Yes – the games are fully flexible, so you can get a refund if you don't play. Gift vouchers are non-refundable.

If we play with multiple teams, will we follow each other?

Generally not – teams usually separate as they solve clues at different speeds.

I’d like to book for three or more teams. Anything I should know?

If you're running an event for three or more teams, or it's just really important to you that you understand how everything works, then here are some top tips to get the best out of your game:

Prepare: check out the How it works page.
Put yourself down as the captain of Team 1. Only the Team 1 captain can begin the game, so you’ll be in control.

IS MY TICKET REFUNDABLE?

Tickets are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged. You can, however, take advantage of Ticket Refund Protection via our partner Secure My Booking. Please see our Terms and Conditions for more information.

CAN I CHANGE THE DATE OF MY TICKETS?

Unfortunately, we do not allow tickets to be exchanged or altered after booking.

DO I NEED TO PRINT MY TICKET?

No, you do not need to print your ticket.

When you book, you will receive a unique QR code via email from our ticketing partner On The Stage.

Simply show this at the door!

CAN I PURCHASE TICKETS ON THE DAY AND AT THE VENUE?

Tickets on the door are subject to availability and therefore we cannot guarantee entry if you do not book in advance. We recommend you book tickets in advance as this will guarantee the best price and because some timeslots sell out well in advance.

CAN I TRANSFER MY TICKET(S) TO ANOTHER PERSON?

Unfortunately, we do not allow the exchange or transferring of your tickets.

CAN I PURCHASE A PHANTOM PEAK GIFT VOUCHER?

Phantom Peak will return on 4th December 2026 and Gift Vouchers will be available soon for our new home at Westfield Stratford City.

Until they are available, you can find out more about our new venue and sign up to the waitlist for ticket releases.

CAN I MAKE A GROUP BOOKING?

Yes, group bookings are available for Phantom Peak.

For groups of 10+, please enquire today for more information on group rates and availability. We can accommodate groups of various sizes and can customise your experience to meet your specific needs.

Whether you're planning a corporate team-building event, a birthday party, or a family reunion, Phantom Peak is the place to be!

FIND OUT MORE

DO YOU OFFER STUDENT DISCOUNT?

We do not offer a Student Discount however, we are pleased to be bringing back our popular Young Adult Admission tickets for 18-25s. This gives you a great discount on tickets! You can book these through our Tickets page

DO YOU CHARGE A BOOKING FEE?

Yes, each transaction will be charged a 5% Booking Fee on the total order value which goes towards the following:

Credit Card & other charges related to payment

Systems to improve your bookin

Expanded FAQs snippet: QUESTIONS ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE
WHAT IS PHANTOM PEAK?

Phantom Peak is an open-world immersive experience. Step into a real life video game and explore the entire town at your own pace. Your adventure, your way. Time moves on and there are new stories to discover every 3-4 months.

You'll go on a series of trails, where you'll be tasked with helping the townsfolk. You'll use our Jonassist Web App to explore the town, which can be accessed on your mobile phone. You'll need to find clues on noticeboards, watch videos, interact with technology and speak to characters to progress. There are new trails every season, and most people complete 1-2 per visit.

Throughout your visit, there are opportunities for great Food & Drink including speciality cocktails and sweet treats. You can also have a shot at games across town including Platyhooks by the lake or the carnival games inside.

WHERE IS PHANTOM PEAK?

Phantom Peak London isn't open just yet, but we will be at Phantom Peak, Chestnut Plaza, Westfield Ave, Montfichet Rd, London E20 1GL

IS THERE AN AGE REQUIREMENT?

Everybody is welcome at Phantom Peak! Tourists under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times.

HOW LONG IS THE EXPERIENCE?

Your ticket gives you access to Phantom Peak for the full experience, which lasts up to four hours.

Upon entry, you will be able to explore the town until the opening ceremony begins. This is usually 20 minutes after the first entry. Around 30 minutes before the end of the experience, tourists will need to return to Town Square for the Closing Ceremony.

While you are able to leave at any time, re-entry is not permitted. We recommend staying for the entire Phantom Peak experience.

WHAT TYPE OF CLOTHING SHOULD I WEAR?

We recommend wearing comfortable, sensible shoes & clothing as the experience requires walking around a large town.

Some tourists like to dress up, please see our Roleplaying Guidelines for more information about what is appropriate.

Please note that real or fake weapons are strictly prohibited. These are not allowed in the venue and you may be denied entry.

ARE THERE FLASHING LIGHTS, STROBE, HAZE OR OTHER EFFECTS TO BE AWARE OF?

Yes - Phantom Peak uses lighting effects throughout, from point of entry,  which is an integral part of the experience. These lighting effects include flashing lights, haze and loud noises.

Phantom Peak does not use strobe lighting, however there are recurring flashing lights, especially during the Opening and Closing ceremony.

Please see our Accessibility FAQs for more information, or contact us if you have any questions.

IS THERE FOOD AND DRINK AVAILABLE?

There is food & drink available throughout your visit to Phantom Peak London.

We offer a variety of alcoholic & non-alcoholic drinks including speciality cocktails & mocktails. We have multiple bars on site, which are opened depending on the season.

Unless specified, your ticket does not include food & drink and these must be purchased separately.

Please note, it is against our Terms and Conditions to bring Food or Drink from outside into our venue. There are bins on entry for anything that cannot be permitted in the experience.

CAN I TAKE PHOTOS OR RECORD THE EXPERIENCE?

You are free to take photos and videos of your experience using a mobile phone or small camera. We cannot permit professional recording equipment unless previously authorised prior to your visit. 

If you take any photos or videos, please share them with your friends & family, or with us on Social Media!

CAN I BE SEATED DURING THE EXPERIENCE?

There are some chairs, benches, and other places for tourists to sit down while at Phantom Peak. These are located across the town.

The experience is best experienced when you move around the town. You will need to interact with technology, the set, and our live actors throughout to really get the most out of Phantom Peak. In many instances, there won't be an option to sit down during these interactions.

You may find yourself queuing when you first arrive with no seating available.

ARE THERE TOILETS?

Yes, there are toilets available on site for all guests to use including baby changing facilities and accessible toilets. Please note that all of our toilets are gender neutral.

DO I NEED TO SPEAK TO PEOPLE?

You will find yourself speaking to people while at Phantom Peak - however, there's nothing to be worried about, our townsfolk will adjust to you. The more you give to Phantom Peak, the more it gives back.

Phantom Peak is best experienced through 'trails'. They are mini stories, or quests, to complete throughout town. Each season, there are at least 10 trails to complete and each one takes about an hour.

A trail is a series of steps, including interacting with technology, our set, and live actors.

CAN YOU BRING PETS TO PHANTOM PEAK?

Unfortunately not. Phantom Peak can only grant access to registered or validated service dogs. We advise you contact us in advance to discuss your visit.

WHAT TIME SHOULD I ARRIVE?

We recommend you arrive up to 30 minutes before your ticketed time. This gives you time to check in, explore and soak up the atmosphere! Late arrivals may be admitted where possible, but entry cannot be guaranteed once the show has started.

Visiting on a concert or match day?

Phantom Peak is a short walk from London Stadium and the area can become extremely busy during major events. On these days, please allow an additional 30–60 minutes for your journey.

IS IT AN INDOOR OR OUTDOOR EXPERIENCE?

Phantom Peak London is a fully indoor experience, so you can enjoy your visit to town whatever the weather!

DO YOU OFFER PARTNERSHIP OR MEDIA OPPORTUNITIES?

Yes, we do offer partnership and media opportunities for Phantom Peak. If you are interested in partnering with us, please send an email to our team at contact@phantompeak.com.

ARE THERE LOCKERS AVAILABLE?

Smart lockers are available to rent for coats, small bags and loose belongings. They are subject to availability and offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Unfortunately, we cannot accommodate large suitcases, oversized luggage or buggies. Westfield Stratford City also offers a cloakroom service - see more on their website.

CAN I VISIT IF I AM PREGNANT?

Ultimately, this is a decision you must make for yourself. There are flashing lights and some sudden loud noises. On busy days, there may be large crowds with little seating available.

We believe that the experience is suitable for pregnant guests. You explore Phantom Peak at your own pace but it does involve walking across a large venue to various parts of the town. 

If you have any questions, you can contact the team at contact@phantompeak.com

WHAT ABOUT INFANTS / BABIES?

Infants are welcome at Phantom Peak. Please choose a free infant ticket when booking your tickets. Children aged 3 and under visit for free with these tickets. Everybody under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times.

Please note that there is no buggy park at Phantom Peak, and limited locker space. We do have baby changing facilities available. 

You can contact us for more information at contact@phantompeak.com

WHERE CAN I GET TICKETS?

Tickets for Phantom Peak London are coming soon and will be available right here at phantompeak.com
That's the website you are on right now, so you're in the right place.

SIGN UP FOR TICKET NOTIFICATIONS

Price FAQ text: HOW MUCH DOES A TICKET TO PHANTOM PEAK COST?

Tickets to Phantom Peak cost between £39.90 and £65.10 for an adult or £29.40-£53.55 for those under 18. Prices depend on the popularity of dates and anticipated demand - a date further in the future will usually be cheaper!

Phantom Peak uses dynamic pricing across all ticket types as this allows our returning customers, Guild members & mailing list subscribers to access the best price ahead of time. Prices depend on the popularity of a specific timeslot, and rise on a sliding scale. Prices may change at any time, but once added to your basket you have secured that price.

Please note that we do add a 5% booking fee to all orders which allows us to keep the core price of tickets lower.

We offer the best pricing in advance, and so we recommend booking ahead or during presale events to get the best price. You can also sign up to our mailing list for access early bird pricing and some discounts*

* discounts are always subject to availabilit

FAQ Answers snippet: HOW LONG IS A SESSION OF BRIDGE COMMAND?

You should allow two hours from your arrival time for your booking. The high level of autonomy that you and your fellow players will have means the exact amount of time you spend on your ship can vary.

Permalink

HOW MUCH ARE TICKETS FOR BRIDGE COMMAND?

Individual tickets start from £49. Prices vary depending on the type of mission and group size, and you can see the latest availability on our Tickets page.

Permalink

WHAT IS THE MAXIMUM AND MINIMUM CREW SIZE?

A ship requires a minimum of four crew members to operate. It can accommodate a crew of up to 14 people, all of whom will have jobs to do.

Please note that unless you buy all the tickets for a specific slot, you are likely to be playing with other bookers who have purchased tickets for the same slot. To book a ship for exclusive use for your group, book a Private Mission.

If you're a small booking or an individual, but would like to play with a full bridge crew of actors, consider our Elite Crew bookings.

Permalink

DO YOU OFFER GROUP BOOKINGS?

Yes, we offer group bookings at Bridge Command. Whether you’re bringing friends, celebrating a birthday, or organising a corporate event, your crew can take over the starship for a private mission.

For smaller groups, our Elite Crew Booking option lets actors fill in as your fellow officers so you still get the full starship experience.

Permalink

WHAT SHOULD I WEAR?

Wear comfortable shoes! You won't be doing much running, but a starship is a place for sensible footwear.

Uniforms are provided to all players, and can be worn like overalls. For this reason any attire is welcome, although long skirts and dresses that cannot easily be tucked into overalls are not recommended, and jeans can lead to the uniforms being a tight fit, so are best avoided.

Permalink

CAN I TAKE PHOTOS OF MY GAME?

Photography using mobile phones is permitted, as long as you secure consent from those who will be in the photograph, including Bridge Command staff. Video is not permitted.

Please do not bring professional camera equipment on your mission, you will be asked to leave this behind.

Permalink

DO YOU SELL DRINKS?

Yes. The venue has a bar which will usually be open both before and after your booking. 

To visit our bar without attending a mission, you can buy a Bar Ticket, the price of which includes a free drink.

Permalink

DO YOU SELL FOOD?

The Mess (our bar) has three flavours of potato crisps available.

Permalink

WHAT IS YOUR LATECOMERS POLICY?

Please be on time. We cannot guarantee that any latecomers will be admitted. This is due to the way the show is structured and the difficulty of introducing a player late. Refunds cannot be given in the event of lateness, and only tickets with purchased ticket protection can be moved to another time.

Permalink

WHAT’S YOUR REFUND, CANCELLATION AND REBOOKING POLICY?

Tickets purchased with Ticket Protection (£3.49 per ticket) are eligible to be moved to a different
</untrusted_web_content>

Bridge Command Age FAQ: WHAT AGE IS THIS SUITABLE FOR?

Bridge Command can be played by anyone over the age of 16. For under-16s, please book a private Cadet Mission, at which anyone over the age of 11 is welcome to play.

To purchase alcohol on site, you may be asked to provide proof of age if you look under 25. In line with legislation, only physical ID can be used to prove your age. Please bring this with you or you will not be able to purchase alcohol. Your right to participate in the experience itself will be unaffected.

Permalink

CAN I BRING A DOG OR OTHER ANIMAL?

Guide or assistance dogs are welcome.

Permalink

HOW MUCH OF THE EXPERIENCE IS WHEELCHAIR-ACCESSIBLE?

The venue and set has been designed to be wheelchair-accessible throughout. Contact us if you require further information.

Permalink

I HAVE OTHER ACCESSIBILITY REQUIREMENTS, CAN YOU HELP?

For any accessibility issues not listed here, please contact us.

THE MURDÉR EXPRESS PART DEUX - JEWEL OF THE EMPIRE

Pedley Street Station, East London, 1937

The year is 1937, the height of the British Empire, and Britain’s most famous archeologist, Dr. Errol Earhart, has unearthed the world’s most valuable diamond, the Jewel of the Empire, which is being transported to the Von Cleethorpes estate via Pedley Street station’s, Murdér Express.

Along for the journey are a host of new characters, including the dashing Errol Earhart and the mysterious Saskia Selikhov as well as some familiar faces...

...It’s not long before the diamond is missing, bodies are beginning to pile up and the clock is ticking to catch a killer and recover the Jewel of the Empire.

We welcome you on board for an incredible murder mystery with a delicious 3 course menu…

…But remember, all is not as it seems and everybody is a suspect, even you.

THE EXPERIENCE
Bespoke menu

A culinary journey like no other, where you’ll savour a bespoke 3-course menu curated exclusively for this experience by award-winning restaurant Lunar.

Crafted cocktails

Meticulously crafted cocktails inspired by the ‘30s. Toast to an evening of excitement and intrigue, as surprising twists and turns simmer to the surface.

Immersive experience

Onboard The Murdér Express, you’ll be transported back to a bygone era. Get ready to immerse yourself in this unparalleled theatrical experience with talented live actors.

THE MENU

The lights are dim, the whistle blows, and your adventure aboard The Murdér Express begins. As the mystery unfolds around you, a brand-new seasonal menu will be served, created in partnership with award-winning restaurant Lunar, based at the World of Wedgwood in Staffordshire.

With a place in the Michelin Guide, the Top 10% Restaurants in the World according to TripAdvisor and a reputation for bold flavours and exceptional quality, Lunar has created a menu suited for first-class travel in 1937.

So, settle into your seat, raise a glass, and enjoy every course as secrets are spilled, alliances shift, and the fate of the world’s most valuable diamond unfolds before your eyes.

Time Out says
What is it? 

Co-scripted by BBC’s Sherlock creators Steven Moffat and Mark Gatiss, ‘Sherlock: The Game Is Now’ begins with the master detective mysteriously missing in action. Enter you and your hand-picked gang of fellow sleuths, tasked with solving a juicy selection of three-patch problems during a 90-minute sesh in a secret central London location. Naturally, you’ll get help (and hindrance) from original cast members, including the high-functioning sociopath of 221B Baker Street himself. 

The journey begins in ‘Doyle’s Opticians’ (as in Arthur Conan), a cover for a ‘spy training agency’ that looks so realistic shoppers have been wandering in asking to get their eyes tested. Listen carefully and you’ll hear Dr John Watson’s (Martin Freeman) voice on the speakers. With the guidance of an actor, you’re ushered in to a secret room to start your mission as rookie spies out to rescue Mycroft. But the play within the play really starts at 221B Baker Street, an exact replica of Sherlock’s living room, recreated with the help of the show’s designer. Maniacal Irish villain Jim Moriarty (Andrew Scott), exasperated Dr Watson (Martin Freeman) and supercilious Mycroft  (Gatiss again) all pop up through footage featuring that familiar quick and caustic logorrhea. 

Why go? 

For an escape room without the cheesy patter delivered by plummy-voiced drama school grads. Everything is designed to test your mental agility, so there are no physical tasks here – it’s all about opening the door to your mind palace. 

Don’t miss

The next door experience ‘Sherlock: The Mind of Moriarty’, in which you travel through the devious villain’s memories to defeat him from the inside. Oh, and don’t miss the secret speakeasy cocktail bar, either. 

When to visit

The escape room runs escapes from Tuesday to Sunday and every day of the week during the school holidays.

Ticketing info

Prices start from £30 per children and £35 for adults, with family tickets availbel for £99 (two adults and two kids aged 10 or over). 

Find more London escape rooms and discover our guide to the very best things to do in London.

What are Fairgame’s opening hours?

Are under 18s welcome?

While we may not act like it, Fairgame is an adults-only venue. You must be 18 or over to experience a ride like this one. We operate a strict Challenge 25 policy so please make sure to come armed with physical ID - no iPhone snaps please!

Do I need to bring ID?

Because Fairgame is an adults-only venue, anyone who has the good fortune to look 25 or younger will be asked to provide valid photo ID, in line with our strict Challenge 25 policy. We’ll accept passports, UK driving licences or any card with the approved PASS logo (no photos of ID please). Once you’re in, you can leave being a grown up at the door.

Is there a cloakroom?

There’s a free cloakroom next to our main entrance, so we can hold coats and bags while you go off and have fun.

Do you accept cash?

'Fraid not - Fairgame is a cashless venue. Plastic only, please.

Are the venues wheelchair accessible

Yes, the main areas of both venues are wheelchair accessible. We have some event spaces that are not wheelchair accessible. If you are booking an event and require wheelchair access, just let us know and we can suggest an appropriate area.

How do our games work?

Our games are fun, simple and easy to master. Nobody will look like a clown. When you arrive at the venue, you will be given a personalised RFID card which gives you access to your pre-paid games.

How many games are there?

Canary Wharf
We have 9 bespoke fairground games. You'll have 75 minutes to play each game once (two rounds of each, played back-to-back).

City
There are 12 games. You'll have 90 minutes to play each game once (two rounds of each, played back-to-back).

‍

How much do the games cost?

Canary Wharf‍

‍
City
Choose from off-peak games for £22pp or prime-time games for to £25 (up to 90 minutes to play 2 consecutive rounds of each game).

How do the gaming time slots work?

ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE
What Is Monopoly Lifesized?

Get ready for the ultimate immersive experience because we’ve made the world’s favourite boardgame BIGGER and BETTER than ever before – welcome to MONOPOLY LIFESIZED.

Go large on one of our supersized boards and get ready to play a thrilling game of twists and turns, as you battle to bank the most money. But here’s the twist: to win a property you’ll need to tackle hands-on tasks, solve puzzles, and ace mini-games in our escape-room style challenges. It’s all about teamwork, tactics and a healthy dose of luck – so have you got what it takes?

We’ll provide you with your very own human tokens – lively guides, who are ready to lend a hand, cheer you on and turn up the excitement 300% as you chase properties, build hotels, and try not to go straight to jail. Remember, every turn is the chance to win big, so look after your Monopoly moola because money talks in this game.

Our attraction is an interactive, immersive experience that uses a range of effects throughout. This includes, loud music / noises, flashing lights, timed-rounds, group participation and intimate spaces.

Where is Monopoly Lifesized?

Monopoly Lifesized is located at 213-215 Tottenham Court Road, London in the heart of the West End. For information on travel, please visit How To Find Us.

What are the differences between the boards?

We’ve four unique boards for you to play on, each with its own exciting theme and challenges. Don’t worry – there are no new rules to learn, just more reasons to come back, roll the dice, and collect those wins again and again.

You can see more about our four boards on this page

What is the age limit?

Our recommended age limit is 9+ years for all four boards due to the complexity of the games, however, we can be flexible with this.
Babes in arms and pushchairs are not permitted.
For any queries relating to this, please contact our Box Office team.

What happens when I arrive?

Members of the Front of House team will be on hand to welcome you at the doors of Monopoly Lifesized before the start of the game you’ve booked for. Please note that you may be asked to wait outside the building shortly before the game starts. The main foyer will be open for a limited time before every game, so you should aim to arrive at the venue at least 15 minutes before the start of your allotted game time, this will give you suitable time to use our cloakroom and toilet facilities, and check out our Monopoly Lifesized retail space! Our bar area will be open if you would like to arrive earlier and enjoy a bite to eat and something to drink.

Is there a bar or food available?

Yes. We have The Top Hat Bar & Restaurant operating during open hours. Further information can be found here: The Top Hat Bar & Restaurant.

Are drinks allowed on the Game Boards?

A selection of non-alcohol

Here is an in-depth, live browser-verified comparison of 15 unusual and playful adult experiences across London, followed by an evaluation of the top 6 finalists, three definitive category winners, and two realistic itineraries with geographically matched food and drink pairings.

---

### Part 1: Comprehensive Comparison of 15 London Experiences

#### Category A: Immersive Game & Story-Led Experiences (5 Options)

1. **HiddenCity (007: Shadow of Spectre / Moriarty’s Game)**
   * **Borough / Area:** Lambeth & Southwark (007 starts at The National Theatre, South Bank SE1 9PX; other games start in Westminster/Marylebone, Covent Garden, and South Kensington).
   * **Core Format:** Urban adventure and story-driven scavenger hunt guided entirely via WhatsApp/SMS. Teams decipher cryptic clues, interact with physical environments, speak with in-world characters, solve hands-on physical puzzles, and take optional pit stops in hidden pubs and atmospheric cafes.
   * **Typical Duration:** 3 to 4 hours (approx. 2 miles of walking; includes up to 75 minutes of built-in breaks).
   * **Indicative Price:** From £24.00 per person for *007: Shadow of Spectre* (other trails from £19.00 per person).
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 6 players per team (multiple teams can race head-to-head on the same trail).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Advance booking online with fully flexible date changes and a play/refund guarantee. All ages welcome (under-10s free); under-18s must be accompanied by an adult and must complete the game by 7:00 PM due to pub licensing laws (start by 3:00 PM recommended). Dog-friendly.

2. **Phantom Peak**
   * **Borough / Area:** Newham / Stratford (Westfield Stratford City, Chestnut Plaza, Montfichet Rd, E20 1GL; relocating from Canada Water, opening 4 December 2026).
   * **Core Format:** Sprawling indoor open-world steampunk/sci-fi mystery town ("a real-life video game"). Guests roam freely at their own pace, interact with an ensemble of live actors, complete 10+ distinct investigative story quests via the Jonassist web app, play carnival games, and experience opening and closing ceremonies.
   * **Typical Duration:** Up to 4 hours per session.
   * **Indicative Price:** £39.90 to £65.10 per adult (dynamic pricing based on peak/off-peak demand + 5% booking fee; £29.40–£53.55 for under-18s).
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 6 people (quests can be played solo, as couples, or in small groups).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Advance booking required (non-refundable; date changes restricted). All ages welcome, but under-18s must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times. Children aged 3 and under enter free.

3. **Bridge Command**
   * **Borough / Area:** Lambeth / Vauxhall (63–64 Albert Embankment, SE1 7TJ).
   * **Core Format:** Sci-fi starship bridge command simulator blending immersive theatre, physical consoles, and branching narrative. Rather than wearing VR goggles, players step into a fully built physical starship bridge with specialized stations (Helm, Navigation, Weapons, Engineering, Radar, Comms), donning crew overalls and roleplaying alongside live actors who react dynamically to group decisions.
   * **Typical Duration:** Allow 2 hours total (includes briefing, uniform fitting, and live mission).
   * **Indicative Price:** From £49.00 per person for individual public slots (private ship buyouts and custom actor-supported "Elite Crew" missions also available).
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 4 to 14 crew members (minimum 4 to operate the ship).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Advance booking online. Standard missions are strictly ages 16+ (private "Cadet Missions" available for ages 11+). On-site bar ("The Mess") requires physical ID under Challenge 25.

4. **Alcotraz: Cell Block Two-One-Two**
   * **Borough / Area:** Hackney / Shoreditch (Unit 3B, 127 Hackney Road, E2 8GY).
   * **Core Format:** Theatrical speakeasy cocktail experience set inside a penitentiary. Guests slip into orange prison jumpsuits, smuggle in their own liquor past the corrupt Warden, interact with live-actor guards and inmates, and receive four bespoke cocktails crafted by inmate mixologists.
   * **Typical Duration:** 1 hour 45 minutes ("Sentence: 1hr 45min").
   * **Indicative Price:** From £51.00 per person (covers experience and 4 crafted cocktails; guests supply their own spirits).
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 8 people per cell (can book private cells or full blocks).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Strictly 18+ only (Challenge 25 policy with physical ID). BYOB unopened base spirits (no beer/wine). Advance booking required.

5. **The Murdér Express (Part Deux: Jewel of the Empire)**
   * **Borough / Area:** Tower Hamlets / Bethnal Green (Pedley Street Station, Arch 63, E1 5BW).
   * **Core Format:** 1930s immersive theatrical dining experience on a lavish vintage train carriage set. While actors play out a comedic murder mystery around the tables, guests are served a curated 3-course gourmet dinner created in partnership with Michelin-recommended restaurant Lunar.
   * **Typical Duration:** 2 hours.
   * **Indicative Price:** £70.00 to £88.00 per person depending on date/time.
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 6 per table / dining booth.
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Recommended 18+ for evening shows (family-friendly matinees allow ages 5+; under-18s must be accompanied by an adult). Advance booking essential.

---

#### Category B: Challenge & Escape-Style Activities (4 Options)

6. **The Crystal Maze LIVE Experience**
   * **Borough / Area:** City of Westminster / West End (22–32 Shaftesbury Avenue, W1D 7EU).
   * **Core Format:** The physical recreation of the cult 90s TV game show. Led by an eccentric live-actor Maze Master, teams dash across four massive themed zones (Aztec, Medieval, Industrial, and Futuristic), taking turns inside 2- to 3-minute individual challenge rooms (Physical, Mental, Skill, or Mystery) to win crystals, culminating in catching flying gold tokens inside the iconic Crystal Dome.
   * **Typical Duration:** Approx. 75 to 80 minutes (over 60 minutes of active gameplay).
   * **Indicative Price:** Standard tickets from £47.00 per person; VIP tickets £52.00 per person.
   * **Ideal Group Size:** Up to 8 players per team (smaller groups are combined with other players unless booking a full private slot).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Ages 9+ (at least one adult 18+ required per team with children aged 9–16). Pregnant guests cannot participate due to physical agility requirements. Advance booking recommended.

7. **Sherlock: The Official Live Game**
   * **Borough / Area:** Hammersmith & Fulham / Shepherd's Bush (Doyle’s Opticians, W12 Shopping Centre, W12 8PP).
   * **Core Format:** Cinematic escape room and mystery thriller co-written by *Sherlock* creators Steven Moffat and Mark Gatiss. The adventure begins through a fake optician shopfront before plunging players into detailed sets—including an exact replica of 221B Baker Street—with original audio/video performances from Benedict Cumberbatch, Martin Freeman, and Andrew Scott, followed by access to the hidden speakeasy bar "The Mind Palace."
   * **Typical Duration:** 90 minutes.
   * **Indicative Price:** From £35.00 to £40.00 per adult (£30 for kids; £99 family pass).
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 4 to 6 players per detective squad.
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Ages 10+ (under-18s must be accompanied by an adult). The speakeasy bar is 18+ for alcoholic drinks. Advance booking required.

8. **clueQuest**
   * **Borough / Area:** Islington / King’s Cross (169–171 Caledonian Road, N1 0SL).
   * **Core Format:** Premier escape room facility centered on the cartoon espionage saga of secret agent Mr Q versus the villainous Professor BlackSheep. Offers five distinct puzzle-dense rooms (*PLAN52*, *Operation BlackSheep*, *Revenge of the Sheep*, *cQ:ORIGENES*, and the AI-focused *IAMAI*), as well as a dedicated 18+ horror room (*Post Mortem*). Puzzles rely on custom-engineered mechanical and electronic gadgets rather than generic padlocks.
   * **Typical Duration:** 60 minutes gameplay (allow 75–90 minutes on site).
   * **Indicative Price:** From £31.99 to £36.99 per person depending on peak/off-peak times and room selection.
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 6 players per room (some rooms accommodate up to 7 or 8).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Ages 9+ for standard spy missions (under-16s must be accompanied by an adult); *Post Mortem* is strictly 18+. Advance online booking required.

9. **Escape Plan**
   * **Borough / Area:** Tower Hamlets / Shoreditch (Rich Mix, 35–47 Bethnal Green Road, E1 6LA).
   * **Core Format:** Story-led WWII historical escape rooms focusing on analog authenticity. Games include *The Adventure Begins* (escaping a POW camp barracks), *The Battle for Britain* (RAF operations room under Luftwaffe attack), and *Roll Out the Barrel* (stealing secret pub beer reserves). Props are genuine mid-century artifacts with tactile mechanism puzzles.
   * **Typical Duration:** 80 to 90 minutes total (60 to 75 minutes inside the room plus briefing and debrief).
   * **Indicative Price:** From £25.00 to £35.00 per person depending on team size and day (Sunday team flat rates available).
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 3 to 6 players (optimum 4 to 5).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Designed for adults and teens; ages 9+ permitted with an adult. Advance booking required.

---

#### Category C: Social & Competitive Activities (6 Options)

10. **Fairgame Canary Wharf**
    * **Borough / Area:** Tower Hamlets / Canary Wharf (25–35 Fisherman’s Walk, E14 4DH; second site at One New Change, St Paul's).
    * **Core Format:** Adults-only reimagined vintage fairground. Classic carnival midway games (Roll-A-Ball Derby, Skeeball, Whac-A-Mole, Clown-Shoot) are retrofitted with RFID wristband scanners and live digital leaderboards, paired with frozen margarita Bumper Bars and curated street food stands (Burger&Beyond, Taco Collective, Alby’s Pizza).
    * **Typical Duration:** 75-minute gaming window (2 consecutive rounds across 9 games; plan 2 to 2.5 hours total for food and drinks).
    * **Indicative Price:** £15.00 per person off-peak (unlimited games in slot); £19.00 per person peak.
    * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 8+ players (easy for couples or large groups to play side by side).
    * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Strictly 18+ only at all times (strict Challenge 25 policy; physical photo ID mandatory). Cashless venue. Advance booking highly advised.

11. **Hijingo**
    * **Borough / Area:** Hackney / Shoreditch (90 Worship Street, EC2A 2BA).
    * **Core Format:** Futuristic cyberpunk bingo show. Combines stadium-grade lighting rigs, surround-sound audio, motion graphics, live dancer/cyborg choreography ("Hijingobots"), high-stakes electronic bingo rounds, and prizes ranging from £5,000 cash jackpots to holidays, backed by the Tokyo-themed Lucky Cat cocktail bar.
    * **Typical Duration:** 90 minutes (6 rounds of bingo, stage show, and intervals).
    * **Indicative Price:** £16.00 to £24.00 per person for evening bingo shows (£35.00–£49.00 for bottomless brunch).
    * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 12+ players.
    * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Strictly 18+ only at all times (physical photo ID required). Contains flashing strobe lighting and haze. Advance booking recommended.

12. **Flight Club (Shoreditch)**
    * **Borough / Area:** Hackney / Shoreditch (2A Worship Street, EC2A 2AH; also in Bloomsbury, Victoria, Islington, and City).
    * **Core Format:** "Social Darts" in a Victorian fairground-themed pub. Patented dart-tracking camera technology calculates scores automatically across fast-paced multiplayer games (Demolition, Killer, Quackshot) on semi-private oches, with push-button food/drink service and slow-motion video highlight reels emailed post-game.
    * **Typical Duration:** 60 to 90 minutes oche session.
    * **Indicative Price:** From £10.00 to £14.00 per person per 90-minute slot.
    * **Ideal Group Size:** 4 to 12 players per oche (can host up to 36 across adjacent oches).
    * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** 18+ after 5:00 PM and all day Saturday; ages 12+ permitted Sunday–Friday until 4:30 PM with an adult. Advance booking recommended for oches.

13. **F1 Arcade**
    * **Borough / Area:** City of London (1 New Change, EC4M 9AF, overlooking St Paul’s Cathedral).
    * **Core Format:** Official Formula 1 racing simulator hub. Features 60 bespoke full-motion racing cockpits with force-feedback steering and 5 skill-level handicaps, linked into head-to-head or group team tournaments, surrounded by the high-end Octane cocktail bar and upscale dining.
    * **Typical Duration:** 25–45 minutes for Head-to-Head (3 to 5 races); 75–120 minutes for Team Racing.
    * **Indicative Price:** £15.95 per person (3 races) to £25.95 per person (5 races); team racing from £15.95 per person; "Sprint Social" tournament evening £25.00 per person (includes welcome drink & unlimited flatbread).
    * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 5 drivers (Head-to-Head) or 6 to 12+ drivers (Team Racing).
    * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** All ages welcome until 6:00 PM (drivers must be 7+ to use simulators); strictly 18+ after 6:00 PM. Advance booking recommended.

14. **Monopoly Lifesized**
    * **Borough / Area:** Camden / Fitzrovia (213–215 Tottenham Court Road, W1T 7PS).
    * **Core Format:** 4D life-sized board game played on a giant 15-meter square board. Guided by costumed actor tokens, teams roll oversized dice, advance along properties, and step into 52 individual escape room-style challenge rooms to solve physical and logical puzzles to purchase streets and construct hotels.
    * **Typical Duration:** 80 minutes of active gameplay.
    * **Indicative Price:** From £54.00 per person.
    * **Ideal Group Size:** Up to 6 players per token/team (competing against 3 other teams on the board).
    * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Recommended 9+; children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Themed on-site restaurant (The Top Hat) serves cocktails and food. Advance booking required.

15. **Clays Bar**
    * **Borough / Area:** City of London / Moorgate (55 Moorgate, EC2R 6LL), Tower Hamlets / Canary Wharf (1 Cabot Square, E14 4QJ), and Westminster / Soho (77 Brewer Street, W1F 9ZN).
    * **Core Format:** Interactive virtual clay target shooting using decommissioned, realistic shotguns modified with sub-millimeter laser sensors. Groups shoot at digital clay targets on massive 4K projection screens in semi-private shooting peg lounges, paired with clarified craft cocktails and sharing plates.
    * **Typical Duration:** 40 to 90 minutes depending on group size.
    * **Indicative Price:** From £8.00 to £12.00 per person for peg shooting slots.
    * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 20 players per peg.
    * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** 18+ after 6:00 PM. Advance booking recommended.

---

### Part 2: Deep Comparison of the Top 6 Finalists

The top 6 finalists represent the most inventive, high-production, and adult-friendly outings across London:

| Finalist | Primary Vibe | Value for Money | Logistical Ease | Distinctiveness vs Generic/Touristy |

| **Bridge Command** *(Vauxhall)* | Immersive sci-fi roleplay; tense, collaborative, nerdy-cool, authentic. | **Very High** (£49 for 2h of actor-driven bespoke simulator time). | **High** (3 mins from Vauxhall Tube/Overground; simple arrival and setup). | **Exceptional** (1 of 1 in the UK; zero cheesy VR headsets; physical controls & live theatrical improv). |
| **Phantom Peak** *(Stratford)* | Whimsical, eccentric, open-world exploratory carnival mystery. | **Moderate-High** (£40–£65 for up to 4h of free-roam gameplay). | **Moderate** (Relocated to Westfield Stratford City from Dec 2026; huge indoor footprint). | **High** (Feels like walking into a living video game town; avoids canned escape room tropes). |
| **HiddenCity: 007** *(South Bank)* | Stylish, observant, open-air urban adventure with casual pub breaks. | **Exceptional** (£24 for 3–4 hours of entertainment). | **Very High** (Central start at National Theatre; start on your own phone whenever ready). | **High** (Integrates hidden corners, historic taverns, and real London spots instead of tourist traps). |
| **Sherlock Live Game** *(Shepherd's Bush)* | Cinematic, clever, high-tension detective thriller with speakeasy polish. | **Good** (£35–£40 for 90m high-production licensed game). | **Moderate** (Located in W12 Shopping Centre; easily reached via Central line / Overground). | **High** (Original BBC cast videos & exact 221B replica make it miles above cookie-cutter escape rooms). |
| **The Crystal Maze** *(West End)* | Energetic, nostalgic, hilarious 90s TV athletic silliness. | **Moderate** (£47–£52 for 75–80 mins). | **High** (Directly in Piccadilly Circus/West End; easily added to dinner/drinks). | **High** (Cult British nostalgia; authentic multi-zone sets and Crystal Dome experience). |
| **Fairgame** *(Canary Wharf)* | Buzzing, neon, competitive retro funfair with cocktails and top street food. | **High** (£15–£19 for 75m gaming slot; cheap entry allows flexible food spend). | **High** (Short walk from Canary Wharf Elizabeth/Jubilee lines; seamless RFID tech). | **High** (Strictly adults-only avoids children; quality London street food partners elevate it). |

---

### Part 3: The 3 Category Winners

1. **Best Immersive Game Winner: Bridge Command (Vauxhall)**
   * **Why it wins:** It represents the gold standard of live-action immersive gaming in the UK. By foregoing VR headsets in favor of real, tactile starship bridge stations (dials, throttles, radar screens, weapon targeting grids) and pairing the crew with live actors whose characters react to your tactical and moral decisions, it delivers unmatched depth. It completely eliminates awkward self-consciousness through clear, engaging station roles.
2. **Best Escape / Challenge Activity Winner: Sherlock: The Official Live Game (Shepherd's Bush)**
   * **Why it wins:** While *The Crystal Maze* delivers pure physical nostalgia, *Sherlock* executes the superior cerebral challenge. Scripted by Steven Moffat and Mark Gatiss, it incorporates authentic set replicas and bespoke video performances from the original BBC cast. The transition from the fake optician’s shopfront into 221B Baker Street and the post-game secret speakeasy ("The Mind Palace") create a seamless narrative arc that ordinary lock-and-key rooms cannot touch.
3. **Best Overall Alternative Night-Out Pick: Fairgame Canary Wharf**
   * **Why it wins:** It solves the universal problem of activity bars that either feel too childish, overly corporate, or clunky to organize. With its strict 18+ policy, digital RFID score tracking, fairground nostalgia, and street food curated by Burger&Beyond and Taco Collective, it delivers an effortless, highly social competitive buzz without feeling gimmicky or touristy.

---

### Part 4: Two Realistic Sample Itineraries

#### Itinerary 1: The Clever Date Night (South Bank Mystery & Rooftop Cocktails)
* **Main Activity:** **HiddenCity – 007: Shadow of Spectre**
  * **Timing:** Start at **3:30 PM** at The National Theatre (Upper Ground, South Bank SE1 9PX).
  * **The Vibe:** Low pressure, cooperative, and scenic. You explore cobblestone alleyways, riverside views, and historic taverns together, solving smartphone riddles and physical clues while grabbing a quick half-pint at the game's built-in mid-trail pub stops. Finishes around **6:45 PM** near the South Bank / Waterloo riverside.
* **Geographic Pairing (Food & Drinks):** **Seabird** (Rooftop at The Hoxton Southwark, 40 Blackfriars Rd, SE1 8NY – *6-minute walk from South Bank*).
  * **Why it fits:** After a few miles on foot unravelling MI6 clues, head up to this 14th-floor seafood terrace. Enjoy fresh oysters, Spanish-style small plates, natural wines, and panoramic London skyline views. Alternatively, head into **Lyaness** at Sea Containers (Upper Ground) for world-class cocktails overlooking the Thames.

#### Itinerary 2: The High-Energy Group Night (Starship Command & Georgian Gastropub)
* **Main Activity:** **Bridge Command** (63–64 Albert Embankment, Vauxhall SE1 7TJ)
  * **Group Size:** 4 to 6 friends.
  * **Timing:** Book a **6:00 PM** mission slot (arrive by 5:45 PM for uniform fitting and briefing).
  * **The Vibe:** Maximum team engagement. Each friend takes a critical station (one piloting at the Helm, one on Comms negotiating with alien vessels, one managing reactor cooling at Engineering, and others on Radar and Weapons). It provides an intense, hilarious, adrenaline-fueled 2-hour cooperative triumph.
* **Geographic Pairing (Food & Drinks):** **Brunswick House** (30 Wandsworth Rd, Vauxhall SW8 2LG – *3-minute walk from Albert Embankment*).
  * **Why it fits:** Step straight from a futuristic starship bridge into an eccentric, candle-lit 18th-century Georgian mansion filled with antique salvage, roaring fireplaces, and chandeliers. Enjoy craft cocktails in the cellars or parlor, followed by chef Jackson Boxer’s celebrated seasonal British sharing menu. For casual craft beer, head to the taproom arches along Albert Embankment right outside the venue.

FAQS

Here are the most common questions you have asked us. Contact us if you have any other questions.

What kind of things will I do in the games?

You’ll decipher clues, uncover hidden locations, communicate with characters, solve physical puzzles, interact with people you meet, and make choices that affect your path in the story… Watch this video to find out more.

When can I play HiddenCity?

The games run seven days a week, at times stated in Explore the Games.

When do I choose my time slot?

You can either choose a time slot at the time of booking, or later when you are setting up your teams. You can change your date and time slot at any time before you play.

When do I set up my teams?

You'll set up your teams after you have booked. You can do this straight after booking, or at a later point.

How do I set up my teams?

Sign in to your game, and assign players into teams of 2-6 players. Choose a team captain and team name for each team. Provide an email address and mobile number for each team captain.

How do I start my game?

Once you have set up your teams, team captains will receive a confirmation email and message (via WhatsApp or SMS) from HiddenCity, which includes your start location. On the day, when you are at the start location and ready to play, the captain of team 1 starts the game by replying 'begin' to the message from HiddenCity.

Who will receive messages?

All players can be set up to receive messages, via WhatsApp or SMS. Once you have set up your teams, each team captain will get a message from HiddenCity. Captains can reply with a teammate’s mobile number e.g. “07900 123 123”. The teammate will then recieve a message, asking them to provide their details. Once that's done they’ll also be sent clues, and can reply on behalf of your team. Add further teammates in separate messages.

You can also add teammates in the same way at any point during the game.

How much do messages cost?

WhatsApp messages that you send and receive are done so via cellular connection or Wifi, so as long as you haven’t exceeded your mobile data allowance, or you’re connected to a free Wifi network, your mobile provider won’t charge you for these. If your phone is roaming, data charges might apply.

SMS messages that you send are charged at your standard network rate, or may be free with your phone package. There is no charge to receive SMS messages.

How do the games work with multiple players?

With two or more players you'll set up teams of up to 6 players. If you have multiple teams you'll play competitively head-to-head, in a race to the finish.

Can I add more players or teams?

Yes – sign in to your game using the Game ID and password emailed to the lead organiser, and you'll see an option to add players.

Can I change my team details?

Yes – you can change your team captains and mobile numbers any time before you begin, by signing in to your game.

Can I change the date and time of my game?

Yes – you can change the date or time of your game by signing in to your game and clicking on "update" next to the date or time window.

Can I get a refund?

Yes – the games are fully flexible, so you can get a refund if you don't play. Gift vouchers are non-refundable.

If we play with multiple teams, will we follow each other?

Generally not – teams usually separate as they solve clues at different speeds.

I’d like to book for three or more teams. Anything I should know?

If you're running an event for three or more teams, or it's just really important to you that you understand how everything works, then here are some top tips to get the best out of your game:

Prepare: check out the How it works page.
Put yourself down as the captain of Team 1. Only the Team 1 captain can begin the game, so you’ll be in control.
If you’re concerned about your teams overlapping, then you can stagger them. For groups with 6 or more

FIND TICKETS
TICKETS

We apply a 5% booking fee at checkout to all orders. You can read more about it in our FAQS

SIGN UP TO WAITLIST
 
Get access to tickets right now for our new venue in Westfield Stratford City, opening in December 2026.
​
Email
SIGN UP


IS MY TICKET REFUNDABLE?

Tickets are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged. You can, however, take advantage of Ticket Refund Protection via our partner Secure My Booking. Please see our Terms and Conditions for more information.

CAN I CHANGE THE DATE OF MY TICKETS?

Unfortunately, we do not allow tickets to be exchanged or altered after booking.

DO I NEED TO PRINT MY TICKET?

No, you do not need to print your ticket.

When you book, you will receive a unique QR code via email from our ticketing partner On The Stage.

Simply show this at the door!

CAN I PURCHASE TICKETS ON THE DAY AND AT THE VENUE?

Tickets on the door are subject to availability and therefore we cannot guarantee entry if you do not book in advance. We recommend you book tickets in advance as this will guarantee the best price and because some timeslots sell out well in advance.

CAN I TRANSFER MY TICKET(S) TO ANOTHER PERSON?

Unfortunately, we do not allow the exchange or transferring of your tickets.

CAN I PURCHASE A PHANTOM PEAK GIFT VOUCHER?

Phantom Peak will return on 4th December 2026 and Gift Vouchers will be available soon for our new home at Westfield Stratford City.

Until they are available, you can find out more about our new venue and sign up to the waitlist for ticket releases.

CAN I MAKE A GROUP BOOKING?

Yes, group bookings are available for Phantom Peak.

For groups of 10+, please enquire today for more information on group rates and availability. We can accommodate groups of various sizes and can customise your experience to meet your specific needs.

Whether you're planning a corporate team-building event, a birthday party, or a family reunion, Phantom Peak is the place to be!

FIND OUT MORE

DO YOU OFFER STUDENT DISCOUNT?

We do not offer a Student Discount however, we are pleased to be bringing back our popular Young Adult Admission tickets for 18-25s. This gives you a great discount on tickets! You can book these through our Tickets page

DO YOU CHARGE A BOOKING FEE?

Yes, each transaction will be charged a 5% Booking Fee on the total order value which goes towards the following:

Credit Card & other charges related to payment

Systems to improve your bookin

Expanded FAQs snippet: QUESTIONS ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE
WHAT IS PHANTOM PEAK?

Phantom Peak is an open-world immersive experience. Step into a real life video game and explore the entire town at your own pace. Your adventure, your way. Time moves on and there are new stories to discover every 3-4 months.

You'll go on a series of trails, where you'll be tasked with helping the townsfolk. You'll use our Jonassist Web App to explore the town, which can be accessed on your mobile phone. You'll need to find clues on noticeboards, watch videos, interact with technology and speak to characters to progress. There are new trails every season, and most people complete 1-2 per visit.

Throughout your visit, there are opportunities for great Food & Drink including speciality cocktails and sweet treats. You can also have a shot at games across town including Platyhooks by the lake or the carnival games inside.

WHERE IS PHANTOM PEAK?

Phantom Peak London isn't open just yet, but we will be at Phantom Peak, Chestnut Plaza, Westfield Ave, Montfichet Rd, London E20 1GL

IS THERE AN AGE REQUIREMENT?

Everybody is welcome at Phantom Peak! Tourists under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times.

HOW LONG IS THE EXPERIENCE?

Your ticket gives you access to Phantom Peak for the full experience, which lasts up to four hours.

Upon entry, you will be able to explore the town until the opening ceremony begins. This is usually 20 minutes after the first entry. Around 30 minutes before the end of the experience, tourists will need to return to Town Square for the Closing Ceremony.

While you are able to leave at any time, re-entry is not permitted. We recommend staying for the entire Phantom Peak experience.

WHAT TYPE OF CLOTHING SHOULD I WEAR?

We recommend wearing comfortable, sensible shoes & clothing as the experience requires walking around a large town.

Some tourists like to dress up, please see our Roleplaying Guidelines for more information about what is appropriate.

Please note that real or fake weapons are strictly prohibited. These are not allowed in the venue and you may be denied entry.

ARE THERE FLASHING LIGHTS, STROBE, HAZE OR OTHER EFFECTS TO BE AWARE OF?

Yes - Phantom Peak uses lighting effects throughout, from point of entry,  which is an integral part of the experience. These lighting effects include flashing lights, haze and loud noises.

Phantom Peak does not use strobe lighting, however there are recurring flashing lights, especially during the Opening and Closing ceremony.

Please see our Accessibility FAQs for more information, or contact us if you have any questions.

IS THERE FOOD AND DRINK AVAILABLE?

There is food & drink available throughout your visit to Phantom Peak London.

We offer a variety of alcoholic & non-alcoholic drinks including speciality cocktails & mocktails. We have multiple bars on site, which are opened depending on the season.

Unless specified, your ticket does not include food & drink and these must be purchased separately.

Please note, it is against our Terms and Conditions to bring Food or Drink from outside into our venue. There are bins on entry for anything that cannot be permitted in the experience.

CAN I TAKE PHOTOS OR RECORD THE EXPERIENCE?

You are free to take photos and videos of your experience using a mobile phone or small camera. We cannot permit professional recording equipment unless previously authorised prior to your visit. 

If you take any photos or videos, please share them with your friends & family, or with us on Social Media!

CAN I BE SEATED DURING THE EXPERIENCE?

There are some chairs, benches, and other places for tourists to sit down while at Phantom Peak. These are located across the town.

The experience is best experienced when you move around the town. You will need to interact with technology, the set, and our live actors throughout to really get the most out of Phantom Peak. In many instances, there won't be an option to sit down during these interactions.

You may find yourself queuing when you first arrive with no seating available.

ARE THERE TOILETS?

Yes, there are toilets available on site for all guests to use including baby changing facilities and accessible toilets. Please note that all of our toilets are gender neutral.

DO I NEED TO SPEAK TO PEOPLE?

You will find yourself speaking to people while at Phantom Peak - however, there's nothing to be worried about, our townsfolk will adjust to you. The more you give to Phantom Peak, the more it gives back.

Phantom Peak is best experienced through 'trails'. They are mini stories, or quests, to complete throughout town. Each season, there are at least 10 trails to complete and each one takes about an hour.

A trail is a series of steps, including interacting with technology, our set, and live actors.

CAN YOU BRING PETS TO PHANTOM PEAK?

Unfortunately not. Phantom Peak can only grant access to registered or validated service dogs. We advise you contact us in advance to discuss your visit.

WHAT TIME SHOULD I ARRIVE?

We recommend you arrive up to 30 minutes before your ticketed time. This gives you time to check in, explore and soak up the atmosphere! Late arrivals may be admitted where possible, but entry cannot be guaranteed once the show has started.

Visiting on a concert or match day?

Phantom Peak is a short walk from London Stadium and the area can become extremely busy during major events. On these days, please allow an additional 30–60 minutes for your journey.

IS IT AN INDOOR OR OUTDOOR EXPERIENCE?

Phantom Peak London is a fully indoor experience, so you can enjoy your visit to town whatever the weather!

DO YOU OFFER PARTNERSHIP OR MEDIA OPPORTUNITIES?

Yes, we do offer partnership and media opportunities for Phantom Peak. If you are interested in partnering with us, please send an email to our team at contact@phantompeak.com.

ARE THERE LOCKERS AVAILABLE?

Smart lockers are available to rent for coats, small bags and loose belongings. They are subject to availability and offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Unfortunately, we cannot accommodate large suitcases, oversized luggage or buggies. Westfield Stratford City also offers a cloakroom service - see more on their website.

CAN I VISIT IF I AM PREGNANT?

Ultimately, this is a decision you must make for yourself. There are flashing lights and some sudden loud noises. On busy days, there may be large crowds with little seating available.

We believe that the experience is suitable for pregnant guests. You explore Phantom Peak at your own pace but it does involve walking across a large venue to various parts of the town. 

If you have any questions, you can contact the team at contact@phantompeak.com

WHAT ABOUT INFANTS / BABIES?

Infants are welcome at Phantom Peak. Please choose a free infant ticket when booking your tickets. Children aged 3 and under visit for free with these tickets. Everybody under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times.

Please note that there is no buggy park at Phantom Peak, and limited locker space. We do have baby changing facilities available. 

You can contact us for more information at contact@phantompeak.com

WHERE CAN I GET TICKETS?

Tickets for Phantom Peak London are coming soon and will be available right here at phantompeak.com
That's the website you are on right now, so you're in the right place.

SIGN UP FOR TICKET NOTIFICATIONS

Price FAQ text: HOW MUCH DOES A TICKET TO PHANTOM PEAK COST?

Tickets to Phantom Peak cost between £39.90 and £65.10 for an adult or £29.40-£53.55 for those under 18. Prices depend on the popularity of dates and anticipated demand - a date further in the future will usually be cheaper!

Phantom Peak uses dynamic pricing across all ticket types as this allows our returning customers, Guild members & mailing list subscribers to access the best price ahead of time. Prices depend on the popularity of a specific timeslot, and rise on a sliding scale. Prices may change at any time, but once added to your basket you have secured that price.

Please note that we do add a 5% booking fee to all orders which allows us to keep the core price of tickets lower.

We offer the best pricing in advance, and so we recommend booking ahead or during presale events to get the best price. You can also sign up to our mailing list for access early bird pricing and some discounts*

* discounts are always subject to availabilit

content.text:
<untrusted_web_content source="repl">

FAQ Answers snippet: HOW LONG IS A SESSION OF BRIDGE COMMAND?

You should allow two hours from your arrival time for your booking. The high level of autonomy that you and your fellow players will have means the exact amount of time you spend on your ship can vary.

Permalink

HOW MUCH ARE TICKETS FOR BRIDGE COMMAND?

Individual tickets start from £49. Prices vary depending on the type of mission and group size, and you can see the latest availability on our Tickets page.

Permalink

WHAT IS THE MAXIMUM AND MINIMUM CREW SIZE?

A ship requires a minimum of four crew members to operate. It can accommodate a crew of up to 14 people, all of whom will have jobs to do.

Please note that unless you buy all the tickets for a specific slot, you are likely to be playing with other bookers who have purchased tickets for the same slot. To book a ship for exclusive use for your group, book a Private Mission.

If you're a small booking or an individual, but would like to play with a full bridge crew of actors, consider our Elite Crew bookings.

Permalink

DO YOU OFFER GROUP BOOKINGS?

Yes, we offer group bookings at Bridge Command. Whether you’re bringing friends, celebrating a birthday, or organising a corporate event, your crew can take over the starship for a private mission.

For smaller groups, our Elite Crew Booking option lets actors fill in as your fellow officers so you still get the full starship experience.

Permalink

WHAT SHOULD I WEAR?

Wear comfortable shoes! You won't be doing much running, but a starship is a place for sensible footwear.

Uniforms are provided to all players, and can be worn like overalls. For this reason any attire is welcome, although long skirts and dresses that cannot easily be tucked into overalls are not recommended, and jeans can lead to the uniforms being a tight fit, so are best avoided.

Permalink

CAN I TAKE PHOTOS OF MY GAME?

Photography using mobile phones is permitted, as long as you secure consent from those who will be in the photograph, including Bridge Command staff. Video is not permitted.

Please do not bring professional camera equipment on your mission, you will be asked to leave this behind.

Permalink

DO YOU SELL DRINKS?

Yes. The venue has a bar which will usually be open both before and after your booking. 

To visit our bar without attending a mission, you can buy a Bar Ticket, the price of which includes a free drink.

Permalink

DO YOU SELL FOOD?

The Mess (our bar) has three flavours of potato crisps available.

Permalink

WHAT IS YOUR LATECOMERS POLICY?

Please be on time. We cannot guarantee that any latecomers will be admitted. This is due to the way the show is structured and the difficulty of introducing a player late. Refunds cannot be given in the event of lateness, and only tickets with purchased ticket protection can be moved to another time.

Permalink

WHAT’S YOUR REFUND, CANCELLATION AND REBOOKING POLICY?

Tickets purchased with Ticket Protection (£3.49 per ticket) are eligible to be moved to a different

Bridge Command Age FAQ: WHAT AGE IS THIS SUITABLE FOR?

Bridge Command can be played by anyone over the age of 16. For under-16s, please book a private Cadet Mission, at which anyone over the age of 11 is welcome to play.

To purchase alcohol on site, you may be asked to provide proof of age if you look under 25. In line with legislation, only physical ID can be used to prove your age. Please bring this with you or you will not be able to purchase alcohol. Your right to participate in the experience itself will be unaffected.

Permalink

CAN I BRING A DOG OR OTHER ANIMAL?

Guide or assistance dogs are welcome.

Permalink

HOW MUCH OF THE EXPERIENCE IS WHEELCHAIR-ACCESSIBLE?

The venue and set has been designed to be wheelchair-accessible throughout. Contact us if you require further information.

Permalink

I HAVE OTHER ACCESSIBILITY REQUIREMENTS, CAN YOU HELP?

For any accessibility issues not listed here, please contact us.

Funicular Productions stands at the forefront of immersive excellence in London, where award-winning theatre and dining experiences converge to redefine entertainment. Located in the vibrant landscape of East London, our permanent venue serves as a captivating stage for our unique productions.

​

Beyond our home, we extend our creative prowess to collaborate with other brands and organisations, tailoring bespoke experiences or adapting existing shows to fit our clients' venues. We transform spaces into immersive realms, crafting experiences that captivate and elevate.

​

Our foundation is built upon the shoulders of dynamic visionaries, seasoned storytellers, and dedicated creators who have passionately steered our journey since our inception in 2018. THE MURDÉR EXPRESS PART DEUX - JEWEL OF THE EMPIRE

Pedley Street Station, East London, 1937

The year is 1937, the height of the British Empire, and Britain’s most famous archeologist, Dr. Errol Earhart, has unearthed the world’s most valuable diamond, the Jewel of the Empire, which is being transported to the Von Cleethorpes estate via Pedley Street station’s, Murdér Express.

Along for the journey are a host of new characters, including the dashing Errol Earhart and the mysterious Saskia Selikhov as well as some familiar faces...

...It’s not long before the diamond is missing, bodies are beginning to pile up and the clock is ticking to catch a killer and recover the Jewel of the Empire.

We welcome you on board for an incredible murder mystery with a delicious 3 course menu…

…But remember, all is not as it seems and everybody is a suspect, even you.

THE EXPERIENCE
Bespoke menu

A culinary journey like no other, where you’ll savour a bespoke 3-course menu curated exclusively for this experience by award-winning restaurant Lunar.

Crafted cocktails

Meticulously crafted cocktails inspired by the ‘30s. Toast to an evening of excitement and intrigue, as surprising twists and turns simmer to the surface.

Immersive experience

Onboard The Murdér Express, you’ll be transported back to a bygone era. Get ready to immerse yourself in this unparalleled theatrical experience with talented live actors.

THE MENU

The lights are dim, the whistle blows, and your adventure aboard The Murdér Express begins. As the mystery unfolds around you, a brand-new seasonal menu will be served, created in partnership with award-winning restaurant Lunar, based at the World of Wedgwood in Staffordshire.

With a place in the Michelin Guide, the Top 10% Restaurants in the World according to TripAdvisor and a reputation for bold flavours and exceptional quality, Lunar has created a menu suited for first-class travel in 1937.

So, settle into your seat, raise a glass, and enjoy every course as secrets are spilled, alliances shift, and the fate of the world’s most valuable diamond unfolds before your eyes.

See the Drinks Journey here and the Wine Pairing here.
You can see the full menu here.
You can see the kids menu here.

Written by Katie McCabe
Time Out says
What is it? 

Co-scripted by BBC’s Sherlock creators Steven Moffat and Mark Gatiss, ‘Sherlock: The Game Is Now’ begins with the master detective mysteriously missing in action. Enter you and your hand-picked gang of fellow sleuths, tasked with solving a juicy selection of three-patch problems during a 90-minute sesh in a secret central London location. Naturally, you’ll get help (and hindrance) from original cast members, including the high-functioning sociopath of 221B Baker Street himself. 

The journey begins in ‘Doyle’s Opticians’ (as in Arthur Conan), a cover for a ‘spy training agency’ that looks so realistic shoppers have been wandering in asking to get their eyes tested. Listen carefully and you’ll hear Dr John Watson’s (Martin Freeman) voice on the speakers. With the guidance of an actor, you’re ushered in to a secret room to start your mission as rookie spies out to rescue Mycroft. But the play within the play really starts at 221B Baker Street, an exact replica of Sherlock’s living room, recreated with the help of the show’s designer. Maniacal Irish villain Jim Moriarty (Andrew Scott), exasperated Dr Watson (Martin Freeman) and supercilious Mycroft  (Gatiss again) all pop up through footage featuring that familiar quick and caustic logorrhea. 

Why go? 

For an escape room without the cheesy patter delivered by plummy-voiced drama school grads. Everything is designed to test your mental agility, so there are no physical tasks here – it’s all about opening the door to your mind palace. 

Don’t miss

The next door experience ‘Sherlock: The Mind of Moriarty’, in which you travel through the devious villain’s memories to defeat him from the inside. Oh, and don’t miss the secret speakeasy cocktail bar, either. 

When to visit

The escape room runs escapes from Tuesday to Sunday and every day of the week during the school holidays.

Ticketing info

Prices start from £30 per children and £35 for adults, with family tickets availbel for £99 (two adults and two kids aged 10 or over). 

Find more London escape rooms and discover our guide to the very best things to do in London.

The experience has been designed for teens and upwards but we accept bookings (where an adult is present) for anyone aged 9 and over. The games work exceptionally well as a family experience. What are Fairgame’s opening hours?

Canary Wharf
Tuesday - Wednesday: 11:30am - 12am/ Thursday - Friday: 11:30am - 1am/ Saturday: 10:30am - 1am/ Sunday: 10.30am - 12am

Tuesday - Wednesday: 11:30am - 12am/ Thursday - Friday: 11:30am - 1am/ Saturday: 11:30am - 1am/ Sunday: 11.30am - 12am

Are under 18s welcome?

While we may not act like it, Fairgame is an adults-only venue. You must be 18 or over to experience a ride like this one. We operate a strict Challenge 25 policy so please make sure to come armed with physical ID - no iPhone snaps please!

Do I need to bring ID?

Because Fairgame is an adults-only venue, anyone who has the good fortune to look 25 or younger will be asked to provide valid photo ID, in line with our strict Challenge 25 policy. We’ll accept passports, UK driving licences or any card with the approved PASS logo (no photos of ID please). Once you’re in, you can leave being a grown up at the door.

Is there a cloakroom?

There’s a free cloakroom next to our main entrance, so we can hold coats and bags while you go off and have fun.

Do you accept cash?

'Fraid not - Fairgame is a cashless venue. Plastic only, please.

Are the venues wheelchair accessible

Yes, the main areas of both venues are wheelchair accessible. We have some event spaces that are not wheelchair accessible. If you are booking an event and require wheelchair access, just let us know and we can suggest an appropriate area.

The Games
How do our games work?

Our games are fun, simple and easy to master. Nobody will look like a clown. When you arrive at the venue, you will be given a personalised RFID card which gives you access to your pre-paid games.

How many games are there?

Canary Wharf
We have 9 bespoke fairground games. You'll have 75 minutes to play each game once (two rounds of each, played back-to-back).

City
There are 12 games. You'll have 90 minutes to play each game once (two rounds of each, played back-to-back).

‍

How much do the games cost?

Canary Wharf‍

Choose from unlimited off-peak games for £15pp (play unlimited games within your 75 minute time slot) or prime-time games for £19pp (up to 75 minutes to play 2 consecutive rounds of each game).

‍
City
Choose from off-peak games for £22pp or prime-time games for to £25 (up to 90 minutes to play 2 consecutive rounds of each game).

How do the gaming time slots work?

When you book, you’ll be given an arrival time (approximately 30 minutes before the games start), so you'll have time to grab a drink before you play - we recommend eating after the games so you don't feel rushed!

What do I need to do before arriving?

Nothing - unless you’re keen to get ahead of the game! Once you’ve booked your slot, you’ll receive a confirmation email. If you want to create a team and add your guests’ names before arriving, you can – but this isn’t essential. You can also send your guests an invite, so they can go ahead a

WHERE ARE YOU?

We’re located at 90 Worship Street, London, EC2A 2BA. You can reach us easily from Old Street, Shoreditch High Street, Moorgate and Liverpool Street Stations.

IS HIJINGO AN 18+ VENUE?

Yes. Hijingo is an over 18 venue, so all guests must be 18+ and bring a valid physical ID. We only accept Passports, UK photocard driving licences, or PASS-approved proof of age cards (with holograms). Entry will be refused without valid ID.

DO YOU HAVE A CLOAKROOM?

We do not have a cloakroom, but all tables are fitted with under-table bags and hooks. If you have any large items, please speak to our venue team to see if we can store these safely for you.

SHOULD I LET YOU KNOW OF ANY MEDICAL CONDITIONS IN MY GROUP?

The show contains flashing lights, videos and haze machines throughout, so may not be suitable for guests with epilepsy or severe respiratory problems.

IS THERE DISABLED ACCESS?

Yes, we are wheelchair accessible, and have specific tables which would be suitable. Please let us know in advance or contact bookings@hijingo.com for more information.

ARE KIDS ALLOWED IN THE VENUE?

As a bingo venue, we are strictly 18+.

IS THERE A DRESS CODE?

There is no dress code. We want all guests to feel comfortable, as long as they are not dressed offensively and have something on.

BOOKING INFO

DO I HAVE TO BOOK IN ADVANCE?

We highly recommend booking your Hijingo games in advance to avoid disappointment. You can book and check live availability on our website.

DO YOU TAKE WALK-INS?

We do! However, this is subject to availability.

WHAT CAN I BOOK ONLINE?

You can book the Hijingo Experience and any of the Hijingo packages online for up to 29 guests. For any more, you will be given an enquiry form to fill in and a member of our team will contact you to help you get booked in.

CAN I AMEND MY ONLINE BOOKING?

Please email: bookings@hijingo.com. Amendments and cancellations are subject to our Booking Policy and Terms & Conditions. View full terms here.

HOW MUCH DOES IT COST?

For our main game – Hijingo Experience (six rounds of bingo) it costs £16pp – £24pp. Our Bingo Bottomless Brunch is £35pp – £49pp. We also have other food & drink packages you can add to your booking to take your experience to the next level.

A Hijingo booking lasts up to 90 minutes. This includes an intro, six rounds of bingo with six chances to win, intervals, and music. Christmas bookings run at two hours during the week, with seven chances to win.

F1 Arcade is an immersive experience drawing you right into the roar and the rubber of Formula One racing. Here's how you can take part.

Virgin Experience Days
Joanna Magill
Published: Friday, 15 March 2024 at 10:46 am
Share on facebook

If you've ever dreamt of becoming like Lewis Hamilton, Charles Leclerc, Max Verstappen or any of the other big names in the world of F1, then we have some good news for you: you can do just that.

Budding F1 drivers can now immerse themselves in the Formula 1 dimension thanks to F1 Arcade. You can let the virtual rubber hit the virtual road at the venues in London and Birmingham, whether you're after a romantic date night or a competitive activity to get the blood pumping with your friends.

If an F1 newbie or a novice when it comes to arcade games, there's no need to worry; F1 Arcade offers a variety of driving levels to cater to all skills levels. And if you've got a need for speed, you can ramp things up

All that driving is bound to be hungry and thirsty work, but the F1 Arcade team have already taken all of that into account and have very kindly provided a bar in the venue. And if racing simulators aren't exactly your thing, you can always head to one of the famous F1 Arcade watch parties to watch the Grand Prix with fellow F1 enthusiasts.

You may have a lot of questions about F1 Arcade tickets, F1 Arcade location, F1 Arcade price and more. But don't let these queries drive you round the bend; we're here to help. Here's everything you need to know about the F1 Arcade.
